# Quantum Spectral Memory

> Finite-time Gaussian dephasing: an arbitrary-spectrum storage law and a calibrated reversible compiler for weighted qubit registers.

## Reading routes

- Story: start with [README](README.md), then [model](science/model.md), [examples](science/examples.md) and [interpretation](science/interpretation.md).
- Study: use the single [Watrous anchor and bridge](learning/anchor.md), then the [30-milestone map](learning/milestones.md). The map progresses from local concepts to the complete framework in M01–M11 and from proof and compiler components to the combined result in M12–M30.
- Theorem: [operational definitions](science/model.md), [spectral law and proof](science/spectral_law.md), then [calibrated compiler and resource bounds](science/encoder.md).
- Reproduction: [verification guide](verification/README.md), [exact compiler](verification/band_code.py), [primitive reversible circuits](verification/verify_reversible_encoder.py) and [generated examples](verification/generate_examples.py).

## Scientific entry points

- [Overview](README.md): question, principal results, scope and reproduction commands.
- [Science map](science/README.md): dependencies and reading order.
- [Operational model](science/model.md): Gaussian normalization, deterministic endpoint codes, retained classical records and half-diamond error.
- [Spectral law](science/spectral_law.md): occupancy theorem, all-code converse and exact-error boundary.
- [Encoder](science/encoder.md): certified rounding, dynamic programming, coherent rank/unrank, explicit resources and clean workspace.
- [Examples](science/examples.md): homogeneous limit, exactly specified nondegenerate register and small primitive circuits.
- [Interpretation](science/interpretation.md): variance rates, order of limits and a separate independent-use capacity corollary.
- [Related work](references/related_work.md): inherited ingredients and the specific contribution.
- [Bibliography](references/references.bib): primary references.

## Reproduction

- [Verification guide](verification/README.md): commands, evidence coverage and limitations.
- [Classical compiler](verification/band_code.py): exact rational grid and integer counting.
- [Unified checks](verification/run_all.py): matrix, exhaustive band and primitive-circuit checks.
- [Reversible compiler](verification/verify_reversible_encoder.py): literal X, CNOT and Toffoli implementation.
- [Examples generator](verification/generate_examples.py): rational data and plots.

## Reading cautions

The unrestricted occupancy theorem does not assert efficient diagonalization. The efficient construction requires the supplied weighted-qubit form, fixed true couplings and certified calibration. Fixed-error constant-qubit optimality is distinct from accuracy-dependent bounds. The independent-use capacity result does not permit interventions inside a storage interval. The repository establishes a mathematical and algorithmic guarantee, not hardware memory advantage. The shared learning material describes the project's understanding targets; it contains no reader assessment or personal progress record.
